label: Whole-first star dependence
definition: For a designated object u, wholeStar u has edge y x iff y=u and x differs from u. A dependent is every object other than u; only the designated whole supplies a link. This is a transparent model relation, not the universal whole-before-every-proper-part principle and not an independently warranted law of grounding. Its edge definition is reducible; the whole is not asserted to be actual or divine.
note: Analyst mathematical formulation for #336; attribution deferred. See docs/dependence-shapes.md for exact scope, examples, rival comparison and OPEN actual-power/being/unity bridges. No new primitive philosophical predicate.
